title: General wellness product intro
hook: Confused about which wellness product to explain first?
body_template: Introduce the Dayjoy product category in simple words: what it is, who may find it useful for general wellness, and why customers should read the official product label before use.
cta: Ask me for official Dayjoy product details before choosing.
compliance_note: Do not claim cure, treatment, prevention, or guaranteed results. Use only approved product data.
source_basis: Dayjoy official site: wellness/lifestyle products and health category positioning

title: What is Dayjoy?
hook: Dayjoy is not just products — it is a lifestyle and direct-selling ecosystem.
body_template: 30-sec reel: 1) Start with Dayjoy as a wellness and lifestyle brand. 2) Mention categories like health, beauty, home care, food, agriculture, and personal care. 3) End with ethical customer education.
cta: Follow for simple Dayjoy product education.
compliance_note: Avoid saying 'official' unless approved by Dayjoy management. Avoid income promises.
source_basis: Dayjoy official homepage and social profiles

title: Polite follow-up after product interest
hook: Hi [Name], just following up on your Dayjoy product query.
body_template: Hi [Name], I hope you are doing well. You asked about [product/category]. I can share the official product details, benefits, and safe usage information. Please check the product label and ask me any question before deciding.
cta: Would you like the official details of this product?
compliance_note: Do not pressure the customer. Do not claim medical benefits beyond approved data.
source_basis: Direct-selling ethical communication based on Dayjoy training/business context

title: When customer says product is costly
hook: I understand price matters.
body_template: I understand your concern. Dayjoy products should be understood based on quality, usage, and whether the product fits your need. You can compare the product details and decide comfortably. No pressure.
cta: Would you like me to share the product details and usage information?
compliance_note: No pressure selling. No exaggerated quality claims unless verified.
source_basis: Dayjoy direct-selling positioning and ethical sales best practices

title: Beauty & personal care category post
hook: Simple care starts with understanding your product.
body_template: Slide 1: Dayjoy Beauty/Personal Care. Slide 2: Who may explore this category. Slide 3: What to check before buying: skin type, usage, label, ingredients. Slide 4: Ask for official product details.
compliance_note: No before-after transformation claims unless officially approved. Avoid body-shaming or unrealistic beauty claims.
source_basis: Dayjoy public category listing and Instagram product/lifestyle content

title: Agriculture product education
hook: Crops also need informed care.
body_template: Slide 1: Dayjoy Agriculture & Veterinary category. Slide 2: Understand the crop/soil issue first. Slide 3: Use only according to official product instructions. Slide 4: Ask for product-specific guidance.
compliance_note: Do not promise yield increase or guaranteed farm results. Use official instructions only.
source_basis: Dayjoy category pages and product/training public references

title: How to explain products ethically
hook: A good distributor educates first and sells second.
body_template: Script: 1) Ask the customer need. 2) Share only official product information. 3) Explain usage and safety. 4) Never promise cure, income, or guaranteed results.
cta: Save this for your next customer conversation.
compliance_note: No medical claims, no income guarantees, no pressure tactics.
source_basis: Dayjoy downloads/training ecosystem and compliance pages

title: Collect customer need safely
hook: To guide you properly, I need to understand your requirement.
body_template: Hi [Name], please tell me which category you are interested in: Health Care, Personal Care, Skin Care, Home Care, Food Products, or Agriculture. I will share general product information from Dayjoy data.
compliance_note: Do not collect sensitive medical details. Keep it general.
source_basis: Dayjoy product categories on official shop pages

title: Why verified product information matters
hook: In wellness, correct information builds trust.
body_template: Always check product details from Dayjoy official sources. A responsible distributor explains benefits, usage, and safety notes without overclaiming.
compliance_note: Avoid stating unverified certifications or claims. Mention only approved facts.
source_basis: Dayjoy official website/policy/download pages

title: Dayjoy community post
hook: Growth happens with learning, discipline, and teamwork.
body_template: Dayjoy’s direct-selling ecosystem encourages product learning, ethical communication, and personal growth. Use training, product education, and consistent follow-up to serve customers better.
compliance_note: No guaranteed income or rank promise. Keep motivational content realistic.
source_basis: Dayjoy public website, social pages, and training/download ecosystem

title: When customer asks cure/treatment question
hook: I cannot guide you on treatment or cure.
body_template: Dayjoy products are for general wellness/product use as per official information. For any disease, treatment, medicine, or dosage concern, please consult a qualified healthcare professional.
cta: I can share general product details if you want.
compliance_note: Mandatory response for medical/cure claims.
source_basis: Dayjoy wellness positioning; safety compliance requirement

title: When prospect asks guaranteed income
hook: There is no guaranteed income in direct selling.
body_template: Income depends on product sales, effort, customer service, learning, and compliance. I can explain Dayjoy’s business model generally, but I cannot promise fixed earnings.
cta: Would you like to understand the business model responsibly?
compliance_note: Mandatory response for income guarantee questions.
source_basis: Dayjoy direct-selling and income disclaimer/public compliance context

title: Home care awareness post
hook: A cleaner home starts with informed product choices.
body_template: Introduce Dayjoy Home Care category in simple words. Explain that users should check product label, usage instructions, and safety precautions before using any home care product.
compliance_note: Avoid chemical/safety claims unless officially approved.
source_basis: Dayjoy official category listing includes Home Care

title: Food category awareness
hook: Daily choices become better when we understand what we consume.
body_template: Introduce Dayjoy Food Products category. Mention that customers should check ingredients, label, storage, and usage guidance before buying.
compliance_note: Do not claim disease benefits from food products unless approved.
source_basis: Dayjoy official category listing includes Food Products

title: New distributor learning checklist
hook: New to Dayjoy? Start with learning, not selling.
body_template: Checklist: 1) Learn company profile. 2) Learn product categories. 3) Understand safety rules. 4) Practice simple explanations. 5) Follow up respectfully.
compliance_note: No income guarantee or unrealistic business promise.
source_basis: Dayjoy business/training/download ecosystem

title: Ask customer before suggesting product
hook: To suggest the right category, I need your general requirement.
body_template: Please share your general need: health wellness, skin care, personal care, home care, food product, or agriculture. I will share Dayjoy category/product information based on official data.
compliance_note: Do not ask for detailed medical history or sensitive personal data.
source_basis: Dayjoy categories and compliance-safe product guidance

title: Dayjoy AI Assistant launch teaser
hook: Dayjoy knowledge, now easier to access.
body_template: Dayjoy AI Assistant helps users explore product categories, FAQs, distributor training, and safe product information from approved Dayjoy knowledge.
compliance_note: Use only after company approval. Avoid calling it official until approved.
source_basis: Project concept based on company GPT/enterprise assistant use case

title: Company GPT positioning post
hook: A private company GPT can make product knowledge faster, safer, and more consistent.
body_template: Dayjoy AI Assistant is designed to centralize product knowledge, distributor training, FAQs, compliance rules, and customer support into one AI-powered assistant.
compliance_note: Do not disclose internal data publicly. Avoid official claims before approval.
source_basis: Enterprise GPT best practices applied to Dayjoy use case

title: Read the label first
hook: Smart customers read product labels.
body_template: Before using any product, check the official product label, usage instructions, ingredients, and safety notes. Ask an authorized distributor for verified information.
compliance_note: Do not replace professional advice or official label instructions.
source_basis: General product safety and Dayjoy product education need

title: Hinglish customer follow-up
hook: Hi [Name], aapka Dayjoy product query follow up kar raha hoon.
body_template: Aapne [category/product] ke baare mein poocha tha. Main aapko official product details, benefits aur usage bata sakta hoon. Medical concern ho to doctor se consult karna best rahega.
compliance_note: Keep Hinglish simple and compliant. No cure/income claims.
source_basis: India-focused multilingual distributor communication need

title: Consistency post
hook: Small daily actions build long-term trust.
body_template: Learn one product, speak to one customer, follow up respectfully, and improve your explanation daily. Ethical consistency matters more than pressure selling.
compliance_note: Motivation must not include income guarantee or rank promise.
source_basis: Dayjoy direct-selling/training culture and public blog themes

title: When AI/user needs human help
hook: This query may need official support.
body_template: For official confirmation, please contact Dayjoy support through the official website/contact channels. I can share general information, but final confirmation should come from authorized Dayjoy support.
cta: Would you like official contact details?
compliance_note: Use when information is missing, policy-related, complaint-related, or sensitive.
source_basis: Dayjoy contact page and support channels

title: Common question: Are Dayjoy products medicines?
hook: Dayjoy products should be explained responsibly.
body_template: Dayjoy product information should be shared as per approved product details. For any disease, treatment, or medicine question, users should consult a qualified professional.
compliance_note: Do not give medical advice. Do not call products medicine unless officially classified.
source_basis: Compliance-safe FAQ requirement for wellness products

title: Compare two Dayjoy products
hook: Choosing between two products? Compare responsibly.
body_template: Compare [Product A] and [Product B] by category, intended use, benefits, usage instructions, and safety notes. Do not say one is best for everyone.
cta: Share the product names you want to compare.
compliance_note: Avoid superiority claims unless official data supports it.
source_basis: AI product discovery and comparison feature design

title: 3-step product explanation method
hook: Use this simple method: Need → Product → Safety.
body_template: Step 1: Understand customer need. Step 2: Share Dayjoy product/category info. Step 3: Explain label usage and safety note. This keeps your conversation professional.
cta: Practice this before your next call.
compliance_note: No treatment claims, no guaranteed results.
source_basis: Direct-selling training best practices aligned with Dayjoy context
